CVE-2018-13410.title: Info-ZIP Zip 3.0, when the -T and -TT command-line options are us ...
CVE-2018-13410.description: Info-ZIP Zip 3.0, when the -T and -TT command-line options are used, allows attackers to cause a denial of service (invalid free and application crash) or possibly have unspecified other impact because of an off-by-one error. NOTE: it is unclear whether there are realistic scenarios in which an untrusted party controls the -TT value, given that the entire purpose of -TT is execution of arbitrary commands

CVE-2026-130335.title: Info-ZIP Zip 3.0 (and 3.1 beta through 3.1c) allows OS command in ...
CVE-2026-130335.description: Info-ZIP Zip 3.0 (and 3.1 beta through 3.1c) allows OS command injection by an attacker who controls the command line. The victim must use the -T option followed by a filename containing shell metacharacters, on a platform (such as Linux) where a suitable shell is run. This occurs because the system C library function is used. NOTE: there is no known common scenario in which an untrusted filename reaches a zip -T call.
